iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: exact registered animation KEYFRAME for an existing Windows desktop pet. The supplied transparent PNG is the EDIT TARGET, the current exact exhale/rest sleeping pose. Create ONLY its gently inhaled sleeping pose. This is a tiny breath, not a new character illustration.
Preserve this exact gray-and-white strawberry cat, closed relaxed eyelids, face, fur shapes, colors, thick dark brown outline, cheeks, strawberry/cream/waffle decoration, tail and both paws. Preserve canvas composition and empty margins, camera, drawing style and scale. The output must have true RGBA transparent background, preferably the same 512 by 512 canvas as input. Entire character visible. No text or marks.
Motion, relative to the 512px reference: both front paw bottoms and toe contours must stay fixed at y≈478, with no foot sliding. Tail and tail base stay still. The soft upper torso/shoulder fluff lifts gently 7–9 pixels and broadens only about 2 pixels per side as a relaxed chest breath. The whole head follows with a gentle 5–6 pixel upward lift, preserving its size and shape rather than inflating the face. The strawberry, cream and waffle move rigidly with the head by the same 5–6 pixels, absolutely no independent wobble or redesign. The closed eyelids remain identical, fully asleep. The lower muzzle/chest subtly stretches above the planted paws; no new anatomy, never stand or sit up. The tiny lift should read like one tender slow inhale while lying on the paws.
Critical invariants: change only this restrained breathing displacement. Keep the two paws and complete tail registered to the original. Keep facial expression, all decorative details and line thickness identical. No rescaling of entire cat, no rotation, no drop shadow, no background, no Zzz, no floating, no exaggerated squash/stretch. The image will be smoothly interpolated from the original by an existing RIFE animation tool. Return one single inhalation-peak sprite.
iterations.decision: Rejected: facial movement larger than head decoration movement.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make one animation keyframe by EDITING THE EXACT PROVIDED CAT, preserving its actual drawing.
The reference is a sleeping gray-and-white strawberry cat lying on its forepaws. We need a subtle inhalation peak for a seamless sleeping breathing loop.
This is a geometry-preserving tiny motion edit: lift the ENTIRE HEAD AS ONE SOLID SHAPE upward by 6 pixels relative to this 512px reference. "Entire head" includes strawberry leaves and fruit, cream, waffle, both ears, all gray head fur, eyebrows, both closed eyelids, pink cheeks, nose and muzzle. These head elements MUST keep exactly the same relative positions, sizes, outlines and colors as the input. DO NOT move the eyes/nose alone within a stationary forehead. DO NOT squash, inflate, reshape or redraw the face or change the expression. The strawberry top, waffle tip, ear tips, eyelids and nose must ALL rise by the same 6px.
The soft shoulders and chest beneath this head follow the 6px rise with a tiny relaxed expansion, giving the body a breathing lift. The two white forepaws remain at the exact original x/y position and shape, their bottoms remain on the same ground line. The gray tail on the right stays in its exact original position/shape. The very small gap between the lifted muzzle and planted paws is filled naturally with the existing white chest fluff, no new visible legs. All limbs remain tucked down and resting.
Keep the same canvas and character size/registration and generous transparent margins. This is a tiny inhale while asleep, not rising from sleep. Eyes remain fully closed and peaceful, no new gesture. Head and decorations remain rigid as a unit; body gently expands under it. Background must be genuinely transparent RGBA, no ground shadow, no text, no symbols. Return a single complete sprite on a square canvas. Identity fidelity and exact original linework matter more than detail or beautification.
iterations.decision: Selected after rigid head/decoration and planted-paw checks. Normalize with the saved alignment, use 0.25 of a 1024-phase RIFE sequence, and correct phases 1..15 with standard FFmpeg floating-point premultiplied alpha to remove endpoint inference residual. Full recipe: assets/strawberry-cat/keyframes-v4/sleep/recipe.json
